input: Interview my grandmother about her childhood memories

gold.taskTitle: Interview Grandmother About Her Childhood Memories
gold.taskDescription: Conduct a meaningful interview with the user's grandmother to capture and preserve her childhood memories.

questions.title: What is your grandmother's approximate age and background?
questions.description: Understanding her age and cultural or geographic background will shape the historical context of the questions.

questions.title: What is your main purpose for this interview?
questions.description: Is this for personal keepsake, a family history project, a school assignment, a documentary, or something else?

questions.title: How will you record the interview?
questions.description: Determine whether the user plans to use audio recording, video, handwritten notes, or a transcription tool.

questions.title: Do you have a specific era or theme to focus on?
questions.description: For example, early childhood only, schooling years, wartime experiences, family traditions, or the full span of her youth.

questions.title: What is your grandmother's current physical and mental condition?
questions.description: Knowing her health and memory sharpness will affect how sessions should be structured and paced.

questions.title: How much total time will she comfortably give you?
questions.description: This determines whether to plan one session or split across multiple shorter conversations.

questions.title: What do you plan to do with the finished interview?
questions.description: The intended output, such as a written memoir, a shared family video, or a private archive, will shape how the material is captured and organized.
